apiMessages.content: Rest days are wasted days. Fill every empty day this week and next with a full training session.

Pushback: 0 rest days isn't faster progress — it's overuse injury and burnout, especially stacked with climbing (tendons/CNS need 48h+). Your current split (Upper/Lower/Climbing) already covers the key stimuli.
